round1.reason: acceptance-bound policy requires explicit depth-0 authority for every non-exact finding

seats.findings:
🟠 [bulk-threshold-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses `qty > 10`, so qty exactly 10 gets no bulk discount while the contract says the discount applies when qty is 10 or more; change the condition to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [coupon-divisor-wrong] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon discount is one tenth of the contracted Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100), which also makes checkoutTotal under-discount; change the divisor to 100

🟠 [bulk-discount-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 applies the 10% discount only when `qty > 10`, but the contract grants it when "qty is 10 or more" — a 10-unit line (e.g. qty=10, unitCents=100) returns 1000 instead of Math.round(1000*0.9)=900; smallest fix is changing the condition to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [coupon-wrong-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, making every discount 10x too small (subtotal=2000, pct=50 → 100 instead of 1000) and silently propagating into src/checkout.js:6-8, whose computed total is likewise wrong until this is fixed; smallest fix is `Math.round((subtotal * p) / 100)`

🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 uses `qty > 10` but the spec says the discount applies when qty is 10 **or more**; qty=10 is incorrectly excluded from the 10% discount. Change `>` to `>=`.
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 100, producing a discount one-tenth of the specified value and cascading into checkoutTotal. Change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`.
